tasks.title: Implement Q01-Q10 isolation probes
tasks.objective: Add disposable probes and raw evidence capture for permitted writes, protected direct/child/grandchild writes, descendant survival, and process-tree escape modes. Probe only an explicitly named disposable target; fail closed when an observation is unsupported.
tasks.test_seam: Fake target responses first demonstrate rejection of a protected write, escaped descendant, missing identity or absent per-check evidence; real Docker execution is a later task and cannot be replaced by the fake.

tasks.title: Implement Q11-Q16 identity and lifecycle probes
tasks.objective: Add probes for durable execution identity, stale identity rejection, cancellation, drainage, active restart and drained restart, preserving per-start generation and terminal-state observations without adding launch authority to the production runner. Exception details committed as evidence must be bounded and must not include secret-bearing values.
tasks.test_seam: RED cases reuse a stopped identity, omit generation/tombstone state, or acknowledge drain before descendants terminate; GREEN requires distinct start identity and observed full drainage.

tasks.title: Implement B1-B10 grading boundary probes
tasks.objective: Add one isolated, independently evidenced probe for each accepted Harness grading boundary requirement B1-B10. B8 must enforce a combined 256 MiB workspace plus /tmp budget and stop timed-out containers by ID, recording observed container state. B10 must emit and validate an observed contract-v2 result against its exact request; never infer a pass from configuration or a fictional fixture.
tasks.test_seam: Each B check has a named adversarial payload/counterexample and its own evidence file; hidden canaries, leaked environment, egress, resource breach and oversized output must be observable failures.

tasks.title: Bind reports and capability evidence to the current target job
tasks.objective: Add the qualification driver and CI invocation that record exact target/job identity, workload digest, policy digest and unique per-check evidence, pin Harness v0.4.0, and validate with its qualification CLI. Pin every workflow Action by commit SHA. Keep reports non-passing until every check and independent review passes.
tasks.test_seam: Mutate job ID, host tuple, image digest, policy digest, evidence path/hash/size, duplicate check, missing check and capability binding; the installed CLI must reject or return not-passing with the documented exit status.

tasks.title: Run all qualification checks on Docker Desktop first
tasks.objective: Execute Q01-Q16 and B1-B10 against the exact observed Docker Desktop Linux guest, preserve raw evidence and record a complete report even when checks fail. Do not claim Docker Desktop qualification unless the installed checker returns 0 for this job and an independent review passes.
tasks.test_seam: This is a real-target measurement, never simulated. All checks run to completion; any failed or not-run record keeps the target NOT QUALIFIED.

tasks.title: Use a fresh GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner only if Docker fails
tasks.objective: If and only if the Docker Desktop report is not passing, run the full 26-check suite in a fresh GitHub-hosted Ubuntu job and produce a separate report bound to that job. If Docker passes, record NOT_REQUIRED with the passing Docker report digest and do not imply the GitHub runner was qualified.
tasks.test_seam: A fallback report must use the fresh job's own job_id, runner image, kernel, Docker Engine, workload digest and policy digest; stale evidence from Docker Desktop or another GitHub job is rejected.

tasks.title: Independently review the selected target report and evidence
tasks.objective: Independently inspect every Q01-Q16 and B1-B10 raw evidence item for the selected target, verify job and report-subject binding, confirm the fallback rule, and run the installed Harness checker. Write a review bound to review_subject(report), with reviewer identity different from the author.
tasks.test_seam: Fresh-context adversarial review against the accepted sources and actual CI job, not only report shape. Any unauthenticated, absent or unverifiable raw evidence forces NOT QUALIFIED.
